## Activity

During April 2022, East City Eye Clinic completed 175 captures. This records the clinic’s activity for the month and provides a basis for routine review of image capture and grading performance. The activity level should continue to be monitored alongside image quality and grading turnaround to identify any operational issues requiring follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the 175 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.6. This result should be reviewed as part of the clinic’s routine quality monitoring. Where image quality is affected by equipment or camera performance, the issue should be documented clearly so that corrective action can be considered and recurring problems can be tracked over time.

## Grading

Grading identified 41 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 21 days. This turnaround should be considered in the ongoing review of service performance and workflow. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk, supporting a consistent record of faults and any action taken.
